enchantments.tooltip: +4 Enhancement Bonus: +4 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

children.tooltip: Acid Burst: This weapon is sheathed in corrosive acid, and does 1 to 6 acid damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 acid damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
Acid II: On Hit: 2 to 8 Acid Damage.
Anarchic I: On Hit: 1 to 6 Chaos damage. Chaos-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Lawful user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.
Axiomatic I: On Hit: 1 to 6 Law damage. Law-aligned creatures are immune to this effect.Penalty: If equipped by a Chaotic user, they receive 1 Negative Level for as long as this item is equipped.

Flaming Burst: This weapon is sheathed in fire, and deals 1 to 6 fire damage each hit. Critical hits deal an additional 1 to 10 fire damage for weapons with a x2 critical multiplier, 2 to 20 for a x3 multiplier and 3 to 30 for a x4 multiplier.
Flaming II: On Hit: 2 to 8 Fire Damage.
Frost II: On Hit: 2 to 8 Cold Damage.

Poison II: On Hit: 2 to 6 Poison Damage.On Critical Hit: 1d4 Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution Damage.
Seeker +4: Provides a +4 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +4 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).

Shock II: On Hit: 2 to 8 Electric Damage.
Shrieking I: On Hit: 1 to 6 Sonic Damage.

enchantments.tooltip: Sundering IV: On Hit: Your target suffers a -1 Penalty to Fortitude Saving Throws for 6 seconds. This effect stacks up to 5 times. This effect may only occur on-hit once every three seconds.Passive: The DC of the saving throw to resist your Sunder combat feats is increased by 8.
